findings.issue: The APR computation does not include all charges levied by the RE, such as the 2% processing fee.
findings.doc_evidence: The KFS shows an APR of 13.5%, computed from the interest rate only. The 2% processing fee charged by Aravalli is shown separately and is not included in the APR.

findings.issue: The KFS is not included as a summary box in the loan agreement.
findings.doc_evidence: The loan agreement is a 14-page PDF. The KFS is a separate screen in the app and is not reproduced in the agreement.

findings.issue: The KFS does not include an amortisation schedule of the loan over the loan tenor.
The KFS validity period is not specified for loans with a tenor of less than seven days.
findings.doc_evidence: Each KFS has a unique proposal number and stays valid for 3 working days.

findings.issue: The cooling-off period is not disclosed as a one-time processing fee in the KFS.
findings.doc_evidence: Borrowers can cancel within 3 days. The processing fee is retained on cancellation, which is stated in the KFS.
